calls.title: Ellipsis Health and GrowthBook
calls.summary: During the call, GrowthBook (Christian Liebenow, account manager; Logan Bates, solutions engineer) demonstrated their feature flagging and experimentation platform to Ellipsis Health’s product manager Amitesh Dwivedi and engineering director Irene Tong. They addressed Ellipsis Health’s pain points of having no unified feature flagging system for their voice AI agent, needing soft launches, ramp-ups, and automated rollbacks, while also exploring future A/B testing.
